The Secretary's metadata: 'Precinct and district attributes from Statewide Voter Registration System (SVRS). Election results certified by State Canvassing Boards. Election statistics certified by County Canvassing Boards.' Published 2025-04-16; latest election canvassed 2024-11-21. The office says it 'cannot assure 100% accuracy'. One row a precinct (4,103); attributes only, read from the Commons' feature service. Dataset page: https://gis.data.mn.gov/datasets/446a973217ce46da9cc96bf43120fbba

Internet Archive capture of the Minnesota Secretary of State's file at https://electionresultsfiles.sos.mn.gov/20241105/allracesbyprecinct.txt, captured 2025-12-29, after the State Canvassing Board certified the election on 2024-11-21; read from the archive in its original form (https://web.archive.org/web/20251229030154id_/https://electionresultsfiles.sos.mn.gov/20241105/allracesbyprecinct.txt). The results site's page heading reads 'Unofficial Results' on every capture, years after the canvass, and the file says nothing either way; it is taken as the canvassed figures because the Media Files' federal and state contests equal the certified precinct table (Geospatial Commons) in all 24,656 precinct totals compared. Used for the results of judges, county offices, park commissioners, soil and water supervisors and county questions, precinct by precinct, and the control against the certified table.
